colorEditPrompts.prompt: Edit ONLY the foreground color of this attached transparent symbol image. Preserve EXACTLY its existing silhouette, all contour geometry, thumb depression, bevel, angle, position, size, and transparent padding. This is a color variation of one fixed app-icon concept, not a redesign. Recolor the entire existing opaque symbol to a uniform solid #9C502F. Every background pixel must remain truly transparent. No shadows, gradients, texture, highlights, outlines, extra shapes, labels, letters, icon container, or background color. Return a square transparent PNG with the identical composition and silhouette to the reference. The one and only edit is foreground color #9C502F; remove any accidental texture inside the shape to make the color flat.
